priority: P0 single-request Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s without MTP

source.base_subject: docs: audit non-MTP Decode traffic ceilings

mechanism.physical_ceiling: Removing one of five row-state shared transfers gives an approximately 1.25x state-path ideal before normalization, global state traffic, FMA, encoding, and synchronization costs. The frozen 1.2448x gate is therefore close to the mechanism's unattainable whole-kernel ceiling.

packed_bf16_recompute.implementation: Each lane retains one row8 batch as 16 U32 words, each packing two BF16 state values. Prediction preserves the production shared-memory K=0..127 accumulation. Update reconstructs alpha*state from the retained BF16 bits, uses native BF16x2 rounding with a per-half NaN override for state stores, and retains the production shared updated-state/result path.

fp32_decayed_reuse.implementation: Each lane retains the first alpha*state results as decayed_state[4][8] FP32 registers while also publishing the identical values to shared memory for prediction. Update reuses those exact registers as the FMA third operands, then uses the same BF16x2 plus per-half NaN override and production shared updated-state/result path.

correctness_and_graph.four_step_in_place: all 786432 state bits and all 6144 output bits match production after every step
correctness_and_graph.disjoint_state: output and final state bitwise; both state inputs preserved
correctness_and_graph.directed_special_values: signed infinities and signaling/quiet signed NaNs exercise both halves of packed words; complete output and state comparisons are bitwise
correctness_and_graph.cuda_graph: one distinct candidate kernel node at grid 48x1x1 and block 256x1x1 with zero dynamic shared memory
correctness_and_graph.invalid_capture: NaN epsilon returns cudaErrorInvalidValue and captures zero nodes
correctness_and_graph.reason_full_model_skipped: both variants fail the frozen first-process microbenchmark stop-loss

sass.method: cuobjdump function-section instruction-row counts on the exact combined-candidate test executable before cleanup
sass.interpretation: Both candidates remove the intended 32 static LDS rows without changing global loads/stores, shared stores, FMA count, shuffles, or barriers. Pair conversion adds F2FP and PRMT work; only measured timing decides the trade.

method.statistic: median of ten baseline passes divided by median of ten candidate passes

decision.reason: Both exact implementations remove the intended shared reload and improve every measured round, but their 0.074-0.076-ms/token projections deliver only about one quarter of the 0.30-ms/token admission requirement. FP32 register reuse removes recomputation yet improves only marginally over packed BF16, proving that the targeted LDS path is not the dominant remaining whole-kernel limiter.
decision.reopen_when: Only a materially different exact state-update topology that removes at least two row-scratch transfers or otherwise has a newly quantified credible contribution of at least 0.30 ms/token.

cleanup.method: apply_patch reverse application of the complete experiment diff

claim_limits: This is a first-process same-binary microbenchmark rejection, not an achieved production speedup or a release latency claim.
The 0.074424 and 0.076402-ms/token values linearly multiply isolated per-layer medians by 48 GDN layers; neither candidate was integrated into the model runner.
The CUDA fixtures use deterministic synthetic activation and state payloads. Candidate stop-loss intentionally skipped a real-model run after the micro gate failed.

The combined candidate executable and console logs were not retained as files; their hashes, resources, SASS counts, and complete aggregate timing rows are recorded here, but the removed source is not recoverable from this record alone.
Production remains unchanged at 105.870500 ms/token / 9.445501816 token/s, and MTP is not used.
